findings.title: Round-5 ledger and progress page under-report PF-20-S03 review usage and state
findings.body: `qa/security-levels/sprints/PF-20-S03/reviews.md` and `verification.md` record Astra review 1 (non-clean, one P2, remediated in `8d6967179`, ledger 1/5), but the coordinator ledger table still says `Local controller (new PF-20-S03) | 0 / 5 | ... consolidate source/tests before requesting Astra #1`, and `securityProgress.html` (lines 373 and 500) still states "implementation and qualification pending" and "new PF20 track 0/5". A non-clean review and a completed implementation are currently misrepresented as not-yet-started in the evidence ledger that release/coordination reads. Update the table row and the two HTML sentences to match `reviews.md` (1/5 used, Astra P2 found and fixed, implementation at `8d6967179`, Fable review 2 pending).

findings.title: Leaf tests hard-fail (RootError::Unsupported) when TMPDIR is tmpfs/btrfs instead of skipping
findings.body: `Directory::open` deliberately admits only ext-family (0xef53) and XFS (0x58465342). Every store/native test fixture builds its roots under `tempfile::tempdir()`, so on hosts whose `$TMPDIR`/`/tmp` is tmpfs (Fedora, Arch, many containers) or btrfs, all 16+ leaf tests fail with `Unsupported` before exercising anything, rather than being reported as skipped/unsupported. The RTX run only passed because a custom ext4 `TMPDIR` was exported. Either have the fixture probe the filesystem type and skip (with a visible message) when unsupported, or document the required `TMPDIR` in the crate/justfile so `just test -p codex-protected-state` is not a silent environment-dependent failure.

overall_explanation: Reviewed the full base→HEAD diff read-only (no tests, no nested reviewers). The leaf crate honors the stated invariants: one-shot O_EXCL enrollment fence with authenticated Genesis and complete owner/key/namespace/installation binding in the HMAC'd head; exact full-value CAS with strict +1 successor and non-decreasing policy/run generations (matching PF-41 chain rules and Core's `validate_successor`); lifetime flock + process mutex; openat2 no-follow/no-magiclink/beneath/no-xdev descriptor-relative IO with private-mode, single-link, regular-file and 16 KiB bounds; file fsync → atomic renameat → directory fsync with pending/torn/permission-drift/ambiguous outcomes latching unavailable and never falling back. Native transport requires a live `Child`, pidfd liveness, SO_PEERCRED PID match (socketpair negative control), fresh per-channel key, direction+sequence HMAC, absolute frame deadlines, nonblocking fail-closed connect (Astra P2 remediation verified in code and backlog test), and consumes the capability on any error; uncertain compare transport is mapped to Ambiguous→PF-41 Timeout, definite Conflict/Invalid stay distinct. Production factories are euid-0/fixed-path only with root-owned non-writable ancestry; fixture constructors remain crate-private. The Core adapter is a pure field copy plus error mapping and does not alter anchor-first ordering; PF-41 root-last is consumed unchanged. Only non-blocking findings: stale review/progress ledgers and tmpfs-fragile leaf tests.
